sql:
SELECT
    g.RegionCountryName AS country,
    sum(os.SalesAmount) AS total_online_sales
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS os
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON os.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON s.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
GROUP BY g.RegionCountryName
ORDER BY total_online_sales DESC
